fixture.setup: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator on iOS 27.0, Release AOT. The probe makes 24 Image views visible after a two-second warm-up, with each view reading the same sandbox JPEG. Record process counters when all image load callbacks complete. End memory is sampled another 400 ms later.

sourceImage.recipe: Random(20261120).randbytes(4096*3072*3) in a binary RGB PPM, converted with sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 80.

limits: Peak RSS includes process launch and setup. Resident memory after rendering was similar across variants.
The native loader uses one decode for overlapping requests. It releases completed entries and does not change file or HTTP freshness.
The Release sample is a repeated local-file burst. Unique URLs, network-bound latency, and compositor presentation are outside this comparison.
